partners.diseaseBName: macrothrombocytopenia and granulocyte inclusions with or without nephritis or sensorineural hearing loss
partners.mechanism_chain: MYO15A (HGNC:23941) —DISRUPTS→ stereocilia development and maintenance (GO:0007412); stereocilia development and maintenance (GO:0007412) —LEADS_TO→ sensorineural hearing impairment (HP:0000365); MYH9 (HGNC:7492) —DISRUPTS→ cytoskeletal organization (GO:0007010); cytoskeletal organization (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ macrothrombocytopenia (HP:0011011); cytoskeletal organization (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ granulocyte inclusions (HP:0030187); cytoskeletal organization (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ nephritis (HP:0011956). Mutations in MYO15A disrupt stereocilia development and maintenance in inner ear hair cells, leading to sensorineural hearing loss. Simultaneously, mutations in MYH9 disrupt general cytoskeletal organization, impacting platelet and neutrophil morphology (macrothrombocytopenia, granulocyte inclusions) and potentially kidney function (nephritis). The convergence is on the broad cellular process of cytoskeletal organization, which is critical for specialized cell types in both the cochlea and hematopoietic system.
